```sql
WITH donor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS "donation_count"
    FROM
        "donations"
    GROUP BY
        "Donor"
),
repeat_donors AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        SUM("Amount") AS "repeat_amount"
    FROM
        "donations"
    JOIN
        donor_counts USING ("Donor")
    WHERE
        "donation_count" > 1
    GROUP BY
        "Donor"
),
total_donations AS (
    SELECT
        SUM("Amount") AS "total_amount"
    FROM
        "donations"
)
SELECT
    (SUM("repeat_amount") * 100.0 / NULLIF("total_amount", 0)) AS "percent_from_repeats",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS "repeat_donor_count"
FROM
    repeat_donors,
    total_donations;
```
